chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey Ch. 229: The Giant Tiger
chapter_meta_description: Han Li observes from concealment as a group of Foundation Establishment cultivators are systematically massacred by a giant puppet tiger fueled by spirit stones. A lesson in Mortal Stream survival.
og_title: A Mortal's Journey Ch. 229 – The Giant Tiger
og_description: A brutal masterclass in resource disparity: Han Li watches from the clouds as a puppet tiger and its wealthy master decimate a pack of greedy cultivators.
twitter_description: The burly man from the auction unleashes his monstrous puppet tiger. Han Li’s lesson for the day: never be the one on the ground when the spirit stones start burning.

lore_anchors.definition: The universal currency and cultivation fuel of the xianxia world, refined from mineral deposits containing spiritual energy. A mid-grade stone is a significant fortune for most low-level cultivators.
The second major realm of cultivation. A cultivator at this stage has solidified their spiritual foundation, granting substantially increased lifespan and power over Qi Condensation cultivators.
A wealthy and powerful sect from a nation known for its mastery of puppet arts and mechanism techniques. They are not native to the Yuanwu Nation.
An artificially constructed being animated by formations and spirit stones, used for combat, labor, or guard duty. High-level puppets can rival true cultivators in power.
A speed-focused flying artifact recently acquired by Han Li, refined from Ink Flood Dragon materials. It prioritizes velocity over defense or passenger capacity.
A traditional Chinese unit of length, roughly 3.33 meters or 10.9 feet. A six-zhang tiger is approximately 20 meters tall.
One of the neighboring mortal countries in the cultivation world setting, distinct from the Yue Nation where Han Li began his journey.
